scoring_justification: MAE cannot be recomputed from raw predictions as per-pixel predictions are not submitted; checker cross-validates per-frame MAE list consistency and compares recomputed overall mean to paper-reported value with monotonic decay.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold overall MAE target for test cell
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper section 3, mean MAE on test cell = 58.05
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: this is the paper's reported quantity, traceable to Figure 4 and Results text

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing the per-frame and overall Mean Absolute Error of force predictions on the test cell. The overall mean MAE is compared to the paper-reported target; lower is better.

output_contract.notes: The per_frame_mae list must contain exactly 181 non-negative floats. The overall_mean_mae is the arithmetic mean of those values. Scoring uses a threshold_or_better policy: if the agent's overall_mean_mae is at or below the hidden gold, full reward is given; above it, reward decays linearly.
